The '''Merthia system''' was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Merthian sector/Legends|Merthian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Merthian lung infection]], a fictitious disease invented at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] in order to prevent [[Tax Inspector]] [[Mothra]] from searching<ref name="CampaignPack">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref> his<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="CampaignPack" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Merthia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-13.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
